ambient_events: The urn burbles to itself, chained to its bracket so it can't wander in a hard bank.
A cupboard latch rattles against its keeper and holds.
Something in the galley smells faintly of scorched coffee and hot metal — home, more or less.
description: The galley — a narrow working alley between the cabin and the hold, every surface bracketed and latched against the roll of flight. A chained urn, a fold-down counter, a couple of crew bunks slotted into the frame for the long hauls. It is cramped, warm, and stubbornly domestic in the belly of a freight aircraft. The cabin lies forward to the NORTH; the cargo hold aft to the SOUTH.
name: Galley
